[[Blind Faith]] |sandbox = No |rewards_increase = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|You have 1 HP, Gain 10% more eco from wave bounuses{{sic}}|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''The Fool''' is one of the curses that appears in the [[Null & Void Event]]. It can be voted for by the players every few waves. If voted for, it will reduce base health and increase wave bonuses. ==Effects== When applied, the base health will be set to 1. To compensate, all wave bonuses are increased by 10%. ==Trivia== *'''The Fool''' is based on the [[wp:The Fool (tarot card)|The Fool]] tarot card. *How '''The Fool''' interacts with [[Justice]] depends on the order in which they are activated. **If [[Justice]] is activated first, '''The Fool''' being activated after it will count as reaching 25% of the base health, activating the [[Damage Buff]] with no effort. **If '''The Fool''' is activated first, [[Justice]]'s [[Damage Buff]] will become impossible to achieve, as players will need to reduce the 1 base health down to 0.25, which is not possible to do through normal means. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''The Fool''' added. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[V1.80.0|v1.80.1d]] ** '''The Fool''' removed. {{ModifierNavBox}}
